root_review.raw_verification: All 16 research captures and all seven selected evidence bindings independently matched against raw byte lengths and SHA-256 hashes. Full July 23 transcript pages 1 and 4, historical Lagos release page 1 and LOS1 brochure page 5 visually inspected. Operator Nigeria map, parent portfolio, rights terms and official WGS84 documentation read independently.
root_review.identity_review: The CEO names the announced large Nigerian data centre, not LOS1. The association to the sole named Nigerian hyperscale project in the operator portfolio is an explicit analyst inference. The historical first-Nigeria release, parent Eko Atlantic identity and named LOS1 map record support the bridge. Edge sites are not conflated with this hyperscale build.
root_review.geometry_review: Copied exact operator-authored latitude 6.4175 and longitude 3.42139, passed directly to Google Maps Marker in the source. No geocoding, third-party map feature, viewport coordinate, survey accuracy, footprint or campus boundary is inferred. Location vocabulary and evidence dependencies normalized without changing source coordinates.
root_review.rights_review: Only minimal restated facts and the operator-authored numeric locator are projected, with all-rights-reserved attribution and terms link. Raw prose, PDF documents, source code, map tiles and media are not redistributed.
root_review.distinctness_review: All 140 seventh-checkpoint names and stable keys were compared. No Nxtra, Airtel, LOS1, Eko Atlantic or Lagos campus is represented. Nigeria is not yet in the cohort; Niger is a different country. One LOS1 physical campus, not multiple phase or edge-site additions.
root_review.successor_review: The operator brochure's under-execution symbol is undated corroboration only. Baxtel's Q1 2026 completed/operational assertion has no linked authoritative completion source in the inspected page and is contradicted by the later July 23 current-construction statement. No dated authoritative completion/cancellation by August 20 was found in bounded primary checks. The public press index is not an exhaustive guarantee.
